standard.summary: 在 backward 过程中逐参数释放梯度张量，减少梯度内存的峰值占用。
standard.effect: gradient_release_mode='post_step' 在 optimizer.step 后遍历释放；'during_backward' 在 backward hook 中即时释放。
standard.whenToUse: 显存紧张且梯度内存成为瓶颈时（大模型/大 batch）。
standard.avoidWhen: 梯度累积步数 > 1 时不能使用 during_backward 模式（需要保留累积梯度）。

standard_en.summary: Frees gradient tensors parameter by parameter during backward, lowering the peak memory held by gradients.
standard_en.effect: gradient_release_mode='post_step' walks and frees after optimizer.step; 'during_backward' frees immediately inside the backward hook.
standard_en.whenToUse: When VRAM is tight and gradient memory is the bottleneck (a large model or a large batch).
standard_en.avoidWhen: during_backward cannot be used with more than one accumulation step (the accumulated gradients have to be kept).

advanced.principle: 标准 PyTorch 在所有参数 backward 完成后才释放梯度，导致峰值显存 = 所有参数梯度同时驻留。during_backward 模式注册 backward hook，每个参数 backward 后在 optimizer step 中处理完就立即释放 .grad，使峰值显存降低到单个参数梯度的量级。post_step 模式更安全——在 optimizer step 后遍历所有参数并释放 .grad。
advanced.intervention: register_hook on each parameter's backward → .grad = None after processing。
advanced.expectedImpact: 梯度峰值显存减少 30-50%（取决于模型大小）。
advanced.tradeoffs: during_backward 模式不兼容梯度累积 > 1。
advanced.codePath: training_loop.py:gradient_release → per-parameter backward hook → immediate .grad release

advanced_en.principle: Standard PyTorch only releases gradients after all parameters finish backward, so peak VRAM = all parameter gradients resident at once. during_backward mode registers backward hooks: each parameter's .grad is released immediately after being consumed in the optimizer step, bringing peak VRAM down to single-parameter-gradient magnitude. post_step mode is safer — after the optimizer step, iterate all parameters and release .grad.
advanced_en.intervention: register_hook on each parameter's backward → .grad = None after processing.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The during_backward mode is incompatible with gradient accumulation > 1.
advanced_en.codePath: training_loop.py:gradient_release → per-parameter backward hook → immediate .grad release
